metadata.description: A rich 6-line statusline for Claude Code with git context, model and reasoning effort, context window usage, rate limits, cache efficiency, compaction hints, and tool, agent and skill tracking

plugins.name: claudebar
plugins.description: A 6-line statusline for Claude Code, each line dropped when its data is absent. Line 1: directory and git branch with dirty state, ahead commits, insertions/deletions and last commit. Line 2: model, reasoning-effort badge, context bar with in/out tokens and a compaction hint. Line 3: 5-hour and 7-day rate limits with countdowns. Line 4: session duration, cache hit rate and lines edited by Claude. Line 5: tool usage counts. Line 6: agents and skills used.
